dialog.heading: Where do you want to apply this new link?

onlyThis.title: Only This Session
onlyThis.description: Apply the new link only for this particular session
onlyThis.example: Example: Only this {{dayName}} session will have the new link

currentDayAllSessions.title: Current {{dayName}} All Sessions
currentDayAllSessions.description: Apply the new link for all sessions on this {{dayName}}
currentDayAllSessions.example: Example: All sessions on this {{dayName}} will have the new link

allFuture.title: All Upcoming Sessions
allFuture.description: Apply the new link for today and all future sessions at this time slot
allFuture.example: Example: All upcoming {{dayName}}s at this session time will have the new link

allFutureAllSessions.title: Upcoming {{dayName}}s All Sessions
allFutureAllSessions.description: Apply the new link for all sessions on all upcoming {{dayName}}s
allFutureAllSessions.example: Example: All sessions on every future {{dayName}} will have the new link
